title: 真实SHA1/SHA256对象格式兼容探针：对象头参与哈希，同格式克隆且拒绝假转换
body:
## 操作任务
实现inspect_format(repo,payload)，payload是bytes，只读返回{format,head,blob}。以真实rev-parse --show-object-format为准，完整HEAD不截断；blob必须由真实hash-object --stdin与hashlib按blob头、字节长度、NUL和payload共同计算一致，不能把内容直接hash或把OID字段长度当迁移。禁止-w、改extensions.objectFormat、fetch/commit/改工作树。屏蔽继承GIT_*重定向、系统/全局配置和replace对象。平台真实创建SHA1/SHA256各两提交及注释标签，同格式私有clone核对图和标签，再记录固定版本Git跨格式fetch实际拒绝且原HEAD/配置不变。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
既有镜像中真实Git与仅自建临时file://仓库，网络关闭，无外部推送或默认身份变化。该子场景核对客户端对象序列化和本版本同格式传输/跨格式不支持；未验证托管平台、CI插件、签名、子模块、全链迁移映射或正式迁移回退，不能据此宣布全生态兼容。
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
rubric: 说明对象、引用或协议的特有边界
交付正反例验收及来源记录
定义失败中止和共享历史保护规则

conversion.original_title: 评审Git仓库采用SHA-256对象格式，应提交怎样的生态兼容验证，为什么不能只把OID字段从40位扩到64位？

exercise.environment: 非root Linux，现有本地原生工具，自有短生命周期资源
exercise.operation: 实现inspect_format(repo,payload)，payload是bytes，只读返回{format,head,blob}。以真实rev-parse --show-object-format为准，完整HEAD不截断；blob必须由真实hash-object --stdin与hashlib按blob头、字节长度、NUL和payload共同计算一致，不能把内容直接hash或把OID字段长度当迁移。禁止-w、改extensions.objectFormat、fetch/commit/改工作树。屏蔽继承GIT_*重定向、系统/全局配置和replace对象。平台真实创建SHA1/SHA256各两提交及注释标签，同格式私有clone核对图和标签，再记录固定版本Git跨格式fetch实际拒绝且原HEAD/配置不变。
exercise.validation_scope: 既有镜像中真实Git与仅自建临时file://仓库，网络关闭，无外部推送或默认身份变化。该子场景核对客户端对象序列化和本版本同格式传输/跨格式不支持；未验证托管平台、CI插件、签名、子模块、全链迁移映射或正式迁移回退，不能据此宣布全生态兼容。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import sys,os,pathlib,tempfile,subprocess,secrets,hashlib
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd());import task
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('GIT_')};env.update(GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM='1',GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=os.devnull,GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT='0',GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS='0',GIT_AUTHOR_NAME='Fixture',GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL='fixture@example.invalid',GIT_COMMITTER_NAME='Fixture',GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL='fixture@example.invalid')
def git(repo,*args,ok=True):
 p=subprocess.run(['git','-c','protocol.file.allow=always','-c','maintenance.auto=false','-c','core.hooksPath='+os.devnull,'-c','commit.gpgsign=false','-C',str(repo),*args],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=5)
 if ok:assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr
 return p
def snapshot(repo):return {p.relative_to(repo).as_posix():hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in repo.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-object-format-') as directory:
 root=pathlib.Path(directory);repos={};payload=bytes(range(256))+secrets.token_bytes(32)
 for fmt,length in [('sha1',40),('sha256',64)]:
  repo=root/fmt;repo.mkdir();git(repo,'init','--object-format='+fmt,'-b','main')
  for i in range(2):
   (repo/'data.bin').write_bytes(payload+bytes([i]));git(repo,'add','data.bin');git(repo,'commit','-m','fixture '+str(i))
  git(repo,'tag','-a','approved','-m','fixture approved');clone=root/(fmt+'-clone');git(root,'clone','--no-local',repo.as_uri(),str(clone))
  assert git(clone,'rev-parse','--show-object-format').stdout.strip()==fmt
  assert git(repo,'rev-list','--count','HEAD').stdout.strip()=='2' and (clone/'data.bin').read_bytes()==payload+b'\1'
  head=git(repo,'rev-parse','HEAD').stdout.strip();assert len(head)==length and git(clone,'rev-parse','HEAD').stdout.strip()==head
  assert git(repo,'rev-parse','approved^{tag}').stdout.strip()==git(clone,'rev-parse','approved^{tag}').stdout.strip()
  repos[fmt]=repo
 print('NATIVE_GIT_SHA1_SHA256_TWO_COMMIT_TAG_CLONES_ACTUAL_FORMATS',flush=True)
 # The fixture explicitly probes incompatible transfer without editing extensions.objectFormat.
 for left,right in [('sha1','sha256'),('sha256','sha1')]:
  old=(repos[left]/'.git/config').read_bytes();ref=git(repos[left],'rev-parse','HEAD').stdout
  p=git(repos[left],'fetch','--no-write-fetch-head',repos[right].as_uri(),'refs/heads/main',ok=False)
  assert p.returncode!=0 and ('mismatched algorithms' in p.stderr or 'different hash' in p.stderr),'pinned Git unexpectedly supports cross-format transfer; revise capability scope'
  assert old==(repos[left]/'.git/config').read_bytes() and git(repos[left],'rev-parse','HEAD').stdout==ref
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:inspect_actual_git_object_format_without_mutation',flush=True)
 for fmt,repo in repos.items():
  before=snapshot(repo)
  for data in (payload,b'',b'\0\xffUTF8-\xe4\xb8\xad'):
   expected=dict(format=fmt,head=git(repo,'rev-parse','HEAD').stdout.strip(),blob=hashlib.new(fmt,b'blob '+str(len(data)).encode()+b'\0'+data).hexdigest())
   try:actual=task.inspect_format(repo,data)
   except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('student format-aware object inspection failed') from error
   assert actual==expected,actual
  assert snapshot(repo)==before,'inspection wrote objects/config/refs or touched worktree/index'
 print('NATIVE_GIT_OBJECT_HEADER_BINARY_HASH_FULL_OID_NO_FAKE_FORMAT_CONVERSION',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
